headings.text: One map. 20,000 players. 3,76,736 sq ft of machines, music and mates. From 120 bpm to 5000 rpm. From podiums to pints. From first-timers to longtime legends. COME UNLOCK IT ALL.
Motoverse where riders, makers, musicians and explorers sync to the rhythm of “Pure Motorcycling.”
Motoverse isn’t just an event, but a pilgrimage for enthusiasts who see motorcycles as an identity and not just a mode of transport.
Regardless of the badge on the bike, Motoverse is a pilgrimage for every biker alike. It was a “Moto Mela” of epic proportions.
Built by the community, for the community, every experience at Motoverse was led by the very people who live this culture every single day.
Motoverse has grown so quickly over the years that it has started to feel like a general tourism festival with motorcycles in the background.
The event was uniquely community-built, with activities led by members of various riding groups, rather than being a passive spectacle for an audience.
This was by far the biggest event organized by a single manufacturer that I had ever witnessed.
It was not an event made for “an audience”; it provided a space for people who live and shape motorcycling culture every day.
It’s the kind of event every biker should experience at least once.

Welcome to the Next Level of Motoverse. Into the motoverse This is MotoCulture Where motorcycles meet art, music, style, creativity and self-expression. A living showcase of the people, ideas and passions that shape motorcycling culture. This is Motorsport Where skill, speed and spectacle take center stage. From dirt tracks to hill climbs, every race is a celebration of pure motorcycling and the riders who push themselves further. This is MotoReel Where adventurers, creators, racers and legends share stories from the road. Journeys, lessons and experiences that inspire the next ride and the next chapter. This is MotoMusic Where the country's finest musical acts turn a gathering of riders into a celebration that echoes long after the ride. This is MotoTribe Where strangers become riding buddies and riding buddies become family. Clubs, communities and riders from every corner of the world come together as one tribe. This is MotoSpa Where everything is for the riders, by the riders, and you’ll find anything you could ever need, from essential gear and epic merchandise to a cold pint. This is Motoverse Where every ride, race, story, friendship and experience comes together. Co-curated by everyone who shows up, Motoverse is the annual celebration of motorcycling culture. Create A Club More from Community Uncover the Universe 2018 2019 2022 2023 2024 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 Epic Motoculture Era Motoverse’s 14th edition transformed Goa into a vibrant motorcycling universe with launches like the Goan Classic, Scram 440, and the electric Flying Flea C6. The event pulsed with the return of Maut Ka Kuan, epic dirt tracks, the Art of Motorcycling finale, and an electrifying music stage headlined by Rajakumari, Raftaar, Tech Panda x Kenzani who brought unmatched energy! The Thump that Binds From a gathering of motorcycling clubs to a motorcycling festival, Rider Mania 2012 marked a pivotal shift as over 1500 Royal Enfield riders rode to Goa. It became the beginning of “The Thump that Binds”, celebrating motorcycling friendships, loyal communities, and shared journeys that shaped the future of the gathering, creating what we know as the brotherhood of motorcycling in India today. Continental GT 535 makes India debut Rider Mania 2013 arrived with a fresh look as “Thump Central,” transforming the festival into a new-age motorcycling hub. The year was monumental with the launch of the Continental GT 535, blending exploration with the thrill of product unveilings for the first time. Customs take the stage Over 3,400 like-minded riders gathered at Rider Mania, creating a mecca for friendships. The event celebrated inclusivity, introducing the first Women's Class in the Dirt Track competition. Custom bikes were a key highlight, with builders showcasing their creativity and competing for top honors, with awards for Best Custom Bike and Most Popular Custom Bike. Riding from Rider Mania Rider Mania in 2015 started expanding its horizons to embrace not just the riders, but the culture they created on the way. Banter between mates and stories became core as Rider Mania embraced art and subcultures. While riding to Rider Mania had always been a thing, 2015 saw the start of riding from Rider Mania even during the festival, because a true rider and their machine are never still. 72 Hours of Enfieldom With the trend of custom builds catching up in the country, 'Custom' and 'Expression' slowly started taking a larger mindspace in establishing the narrative of personalisation for motorcycles - a wave that Rider Mania rode in 2016. The Himalayan Class made its Dirt Track debut, heralding Royal Enfield’s bold entry into adventure motorcycling in India and inspiring a new wave of exploration. Relive Your Ride The #Relive theme defined Rider Mania in 2017, as an attempt to enable riders to relive their kind of motorcycling through the diverse avenues present across events, art, music, community. The India unveil of the 650 Twins thrilled the new-age riders, as well as introduction to the Garage Cafe - Royal Enfield’s adaptation to Goa and its culture. World's largest Royal Enfield Gathering Rider Mania 2018 set history with 6500+ Royal Enfields together, the largest gathering of its kind anywhere on the planet. Fresh experiences like Motoball, Hill Climb, and Custom Workshops amplified the motorcycling culture 2018 also saw the experiential launch of the 650 twins - making Rider Mania the place to be, not just for our audiences and community in India but for aspirers and media across the globe. Leave Every Place Better In 2019 Royal Enfield launched the #LeaveEveryPlaceBetter campaign to ensure we are catalyzing the power of our community to not just explore and discover new places, but to leave them better than we found. This campaign saw its essence within the largest Royal Enfield community gathering and set the tone for values held close by Royal Enfield. Into the Motoverse Post-pandemic, Rider Mania evolved into Motoverse. With a new vision, we expanded our universe beyond riders, inviting new audiences to experience the soul of motorcycling, while holding true to Rider Mania’s core essence. With the launch of Super Meteor 650, launches on the Motoverse Mainstage became keynotes, uniting the company with our community. Headlined by Divine, electrifying audiences with his raw, street-rooted hip-hop sound. The Universe Unleashed Motoverse 2023 unveiled the Himalayan 450’s official pricing, celebrated custom culture with Shed Builds, and launched the Shotgun 650 Motoverse Edition. Music and artistry converged in a new Culture Stage and Spotify RADAR collaboration, with the Motoverse main stage headlined by Seedhe Maut and Benny Dayal, blending powerhouse rap and soulful melodies.
